title: Use terminal-style history and explicit clipboard copying
observable_contract: Typing and paste leave retained history and reach the application unchanged. Dragging, releasing, word selection and line selection only highlight; Ctrl+C explicitly copies an existing selection while preserving it and the reading position. With no selection, Ctrl+C keeps its normal interrupt behavior.
manual_limits: Physical Termux gesture/clipboard UI and desktop clipboard permissions require manual device checks. The real-Codex adapter requires TEST_CODEX to name a compatible local build; generic terminal-copy coverage does not depend on it.
result_policy: Test reports describe a particular artifact and run; no historical pass is asserted here.
